Level: **Intermediate** · 11 steps · 3h 28m of video · Prerequisites: [Deep Learning](deep-learning.md). [Fine-Tuning & Reasoning Models](fine-tuning.md) pairs well at the end.

## Build it

- Train a DQN on CartPole, then plot reward per episode and compare against a random agent.
- Solve LunarLander with PPO in Stable Baselines3 and record a video of the trained agent.
- Write tabular Q-learning for FrozenLake from scratch and visualize the learned policy.
